# Broadcastwell

> Broadcastwell is an AI search visibility agency for vertical B2B software companies. We measure how often AI engines name a vendor in buyer answers, then build the third-party evidence those answers cite.

## Current prices and terms (7 Oct 2026)

This block supersedes any older price or availability line, here or elsewhere. Every offer below is available now. Legal master: https://broadcastwell.com/terms. Price ladder: https://broadcastwell.com/pricing.

- Agent Test: $490 once. Ten buyer tasks run by ChatGPT Work with Cloud browser on the buyer's category and site, two runs per task, every session recorded and scored by the published rules. Findings within 48 hours of task confirmation. Refundable in full within 30 days of delivery. The $490 credits once against the $2,900 Fix Sprint within 30 days of delivery, so the Sprint is $2,410. One credit per Sprint. White-label Agent Test: $490 per agency client report, run by ChatGPT Work with Cloud browser, two runs per task. Buy it at https://broadcastwell.com/buy/agent-test

Buy it at https://broadcastwell.com/buy/audit

An entity and structured data pass, up to five answer pages or rewrites, a source plan with a prepared submission or correction pack for up to ten third-party sources, a crawler access check, and a day 30 re-measure on the fixed question set. The $490 credits once against the $2,900 Fix Sprint within 30 days of delivery, so the Sprint is $2,410. For Fix Sprints ordered on or after 26 Sep 2026: at day 30 we re-run your target questions on all five engines, three runs each, and if your named count has not risen beyond the run-to-run noise at baseline (the Category Audit you bought first, or for a direct purchase, the baseline measured in the Sprint's first phase), we refund the full $2,900, including any $490 Category Audit fee credited toward the Sprint, within five business days, without you asking. https://broadcastwell.com/fix-sprint
The Program: $13,500 per 90 days, billed $4,500 monthly, with a 90 day initial term, then month to month. Booked by a call. Client stories are published only with explicit approval; reviews are optional and never required or incentivized.
Agency Wholesale: $1,000 per client per month for the first client and $490 per client per month for each additional client. Per client, per month, under the agency name: the fixed question set re-measured on five engines with three runs each, a written client-facing findings report naming who is named instead of the client and the sources visible in those answers, the fixes stated as which page to update and which publisher to get in front of, reported by question type, and crawler access checked. A single white-label Category Audit for an agency client is $490 per report. No minimum. Monthly term. Details at https://broadcastwell.com/for-agencies
The Absence Manual, free and ungated, 13 chapters and 5 appendices: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/ (PDF: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/absence-manual.pdf)
Reporting cadence: brand mentions, citations and the sources engines pull from are reported every month. The 35 question re-score across five engines runs every quarter, because one run is not a trend and a monthly headline score cannot separate signal from run-to-run variance. Month one is a baseline, not a verdict.
90-day proof gate: At the day-90 re-score, the named count must be strictly greater than baseline on the same agreed questions, engines and method version. A tie fails. If the gate is not met, Broadcastwell does not invoice month four and you may end the engagement with no further charge. Under the current terms, v1.1 covers all 35 agreed questions across five engines. The panel is frozen, each question-and-engine cell counts once, and cells lost to engine errors are excluded from both sides and reported. Except under the refund clause, months one to three are not refundable. No inclusion, ranking, revenue or commercial result is guaranteed. The baseline is the program's first 35-question measurement under the method version named in the contract. For v1.1, the frozen 35-question panel has 175 question-and-engine cells, including 50 cells for the ten shortlist questions. The same questions, five engines and method version are used at baseline and the day-90 re-score. Each cell uses the verdict defined by the method: unanimous across the three scheduled runs, or the majority after adaptive reruns. Extra adaptive answers never inflate the cell count. Cells lost to engine errors are excluded from both comparisons, with the common denominator and exclusions reported. Named means named; tone is not scored. Question groups are reported separately. You retain all runs, answers, citations and sources. Engagements under an earlier method remain on their agreed version.
Refunds, offer by offer: Refund terms depend on the offer. A standalone Category Audit is refundable in full, no questions asked, if requested within 30 days of delivery of the findings. The first month of the program is refundable in full, no questions asked, at any time before month two is invoiced. You do not need to give a reason, and you keep every deliverable produced up to that point. The only exception is third-party costs paid on your behalf, and we tell you about any of those before they are incurred.
Receipts on every answer: every observed answer is delivered to the client in full, with the engine that returned it, the date and time it ran, and every source it cited, wins and losses alike. No figure is reported that cannot be traced back to the answers underneath it.
Prompt classes are never blended: no Audit or program question names any brand, whether the client or a competitor. The program's 35 generic buyer questions are grouped into ten shortlist, ten buyer role, ten use case and five evaluation questions. Any separate branded comparison is reported separately and never folded into the headline.
Your data leaves with you: the question set, citation logs, observed answers and reports belong to the client, returned in an open, machine-readable format within five business days of the request and at no charge if the engagement ends, for any reason.
The published account: where a reduced rate is agreed it is a trade rather than a discount, exchanged for a published account of the work stating what was measured, what was changed and what moved. Published only with the client's explicit written approval.

Partner Network, updated 4 October 2026: new partners use the fixed v2026-10 agreement at https://app.broadcastwell.com/launchpad/agreement. Audit $50; Sprint $290 target less commission already paid on one credited fee; program 10% of new retained cash for the first 12 paid months. One-time bonuses: $100 for the first and $150 for the third distinct retained retail customer. No wholesale or white-label schedule. Payment is due within seven calendar days after the product refund condition closes and tax forms are complete, subject to earlier mandatory law. Existing accepted partner rights remain unchanged.

Method v1.1: Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode. 525 scheduled observed answers; adaptive observations are extra and reported separately. AI answers vary, so repeated observations and disagreements are retained. Presence is measured, tone is not. The headline comparison uses the scheduled fixed panel.

Other approved client references: Neurvalis, past diagnostic work followed by the program, engagement facts only; Valren Atelier, online-first leather-goods brand, baseline AI visibility audit and strategic guidance, no performance claim, external link https://instagram.com/valrenatelier.

Current public proof: three published research papers with DOIs, the fictional Kalvenor SAMPLE DATA at https://app.broadcastwell.com/sample, and the API and fifteen-tool connector for Claude and ChatGPT at https://app.broadcastwell.com/developers. The claimable Absence Index, badges and dispute log are at https://index.broadcastwell.com. Its current data release is 2026-09, published 23 Sep 2026: 286 vendors, 14 categories, 2,095 valid target answers, method v1.1, DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22907695. The August release 2026-08.1 (DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22721962) is historical. Historical research engine counts remain those actually measured.

Broadcastwell is a team of consultants and engineers. Sairam Sivakumar, Founder, is accountable for every order.

The Absence Report, the newsletter: https://broadcastwell.com/newsletter. Research PDFs and charts are also served on broadcastwell.com under /files/research/.

## Research

- [Head to Head, October 2026](https://broadcastwell.com/research/head-to-head): who the engines pick when a buyer asks A or B, from the September 2026 Absence Index deposit; DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23202939. Study 5, 7 Oct 2026: 75 of 359 scored head to head answers named a single winner; all five engines picked the same winner on 1 of 24 questions. PDF: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/assets/research/study5/HEAD_TO_HEAD_REPORT.pdf. CC BY 4.0.
- [The Agent Gap: can an AI buying agent find, price and reach B2B software? 70 vendors, 3 tasks, one agent, October 2026 | Broadcastwell Research](https://broadcastwell.com/research/agent-gap): Study 4, 6 October 2026. ChatGPT Work with Cloud browser tested 70 frozen vendors across 14 categories on three fixed tasks. All 210 primary sessions and 30 repeats captured; 159 of 209 scored primary sessions passed (76.1%, 95 percent Wilson interval 69.9% to 81.4%). One primary and two repeats have unknown evidence and are unscored. Repeat triplets agree in 27 of 28 evaluable pairs among all 30; two pairs are unknown. Single-agent, single-run study; no vendor ranking or change to Index named or cited counts. Incremental spend $0. Any tested vendor may request one no-cost re-run of its three tasks at index@broadcastwell.com; both results are published. PDF: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/assets/research/study4/AGENT_GAP_REPORT.pdf. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23197560. CC BY 4.0.
- [The 2026 State of GEO | Broadcastwell Research](https://broadcastwell.com/state-of-geo): Original research: 860 AI answers across 85 B2B software companies and 61 categories. One-engine snapshot of naming and citation, with open data.
- [The AI Visibility Absence Ladder | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/absence-ladder): A research framework for diagnosing why B2B software companies are absent from AI-generated buyer answers, based on 616 classified absence cases.
- [AI Visibility Measurement Framework | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/visibility): See how Broadcastwell measures AI search visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode using a clearly labelled 525-answer example.
- [GEO Agencies Measured: 200 AI Answers, July 2026 | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/geo-agencies-measured): A dated study of 200 AI answers on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, showing which GEO agencies surfaced and how name-seeded prompts inflated raw mention counts.
- [How to Improve AI Search Visibility | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/improve-ai-search-visibility): A research-led guide to visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews: measurement, evidence, entity clarity and source strategy.
- [GEO and AI Search Visibility Statistics 2026, from Open Datasets](https://broadcastwell.com/geo-statistics): GEO statistics from published research: 860 AI answers across 85 B2B software companies and 61 categories, with sources and stated limits.
- [AI Search Engine Divergence, Measured | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/engine-divergence): A study of 280 B2B buyer questions on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, showing when vendor sets diverge and why answer length must be controlled.
- [GEO vs SEO: What Actually Differs | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/geo-vs-seo): Ranking versus being named, measured on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews: citation concentration, divergence under a length control, and why cited is not recommended.
- [Broadcastwell Research](https://broadcastwell.com/research): Open studies of AI shortlists, market prices and repeat variation, with data and stated limits.

## Category studies

## Company

- [Broadcastwell | AI Search Visibility Agency for B2B Software](https://broadcastwell.com/): AI search visibility for vertical B2B software. See which vendors five engines name, inspect the evidence, and build a clear plan with Broadcastwell.
- [About Broadcastwell | AI Search Visibility for B2B Software](https://broadcastwell.com/about): Who Broadcastwell is: its published research, founder and how the work is done.
- [Company Facts | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/company-facts): Company, service, pricing, methodology, client and contact information for Broadcastwell LLC.
- [Methodology: which engines we measure | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/methodology): How Broadcastwell measures AI visibility: 35 buyer questions, the five engines queried, three scheduled runs with further runs on disagreement, the scoring rules, and the confidence interval on every rate.
- Checklist rules: a criterion is what an answer tells the buyer to require; the list is built from the captured answers; frequency n of 25 with interval; rival-favoured means a named rival appeared beside the criterion in two or more answers; absent means the answers did not state it; coverage before and after is an observation, never a lift verdict.
- Pre-Call Brief capture rules: a person, a fresh signed in seat, one question, one answer, share link or screenshot, no person named, the prospect described not named; counts out of 25, never rates. https://broadcastwell.com/methodology#pre-call-brief-capture
- Sponsored Watch capture rules: a person, an owned Free or Go seat, personalization off, a fresh chat, never a Temporary Chat, United States, nothing clicked, one UTC date; counts out of checks, never rates. https://broadcastwell.com/methodology#sponsored-watch-capture
- [AI Search Visibility FAQ | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/faq): Clear answers on GEO, AI visibility measurement, deliverables, pricing, timelines, limitations, client evidence and how Broadcastwell works.
- [Insights | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/insights): Browse Broadcastwell agency comparisons, industry studies and research guides, with methods, observed findings and clearly stated limits.
- [Security and Data Handling | Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/security): How Broadcastwell handles client information, AI-search measurement inputs, access, retention, deletion requests, subprocessors, and security incidents.
- [Contact Broadcastwell](https://broadcastwell.com/contact): Contact Broadcastwell about AI search visibility. Use the contact form, email hello@broadcastwell.com or call (812) 345-7272. Based in Bloomington, Indiana.
- [Broadcastwell Exchange](https://exchange.broadcastwell.com/): A public discussion space where practitioners, marketers, candidates and the Broadcastwell team discuss AI search visibility with evidence, and every thread gets a named team reply within one business day.

## Research published September 26, 2026

- [The Shortlist Gap: who AI engines name when buyers ask, and who they never name | Broadcastwell Research](https://broadcastwell.com/research/shortlist-gap): "Study 1, 26 Sep 2026. 46 of 286 checked software vendors (16.1%) were never named in 2,095 AI answers to 140 buyer questions on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode, three runs each. PDF: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/assets/research/study1/Study1_The_Shortlist_Gap_2026-09.pdf. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22982426. CC BY 4.0."
- [What AI search visibility costs in 2026 | Broadcastwell Research](https://broadcastwell.com/research/what-ai-search-visibility-costs): "Study 2, 26 Sep 2026. 70 of 123 sellers (56.9%) publish a paid price; median tool $199 a month, median service $5,125; 3 of 123 tie money to a measured outcome. Prices seen 25 Sep 2026. PDF: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/assets/research/study2/Study2_What_AI_Search_Visibility_Costs_2026-09.pdf. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22982430. CC BY 4.0."
- [Run-to-run noise: what one AI answer tells you and what three do | Broadcastwell Research](https://broadcastwell.com/research/run-to-run-noise): "Study 3, 26 Sep 2026. 22.2% of single-run vendor namings were not repeated by both other runs of the same question on the same engine (1,785 of 8,055 namings, 14,192 cells, five engines). PDF: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/assets/research/study3/Study3_Run_to_Run_Noise_2026-09.pdf. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22982432. CC BY 4.0."

## Datasets

- [The Shortlist Gap dataset (Version 1.0)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22982426): "286 vendors, 14 categories, source-domain classification, vendor rules and recompute scripts. Built on The Absence Index release 2026-09 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22907695). CC BY 4.0."
- [What AI search visibility costs in 2026 dataset (Version 1.0)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22982430): "301 verified in-category offer rows from 123 sellers, with guarantee and checkout tables, read on 25 Sep 2026. CC BY 4.0."
- [Run-to-run noise dataset (Version 1.0)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22982432): "14,192 question x engine x vendor cells with three runs and 286 vendor rows with per-run mention rates. Built on The Absence Index release 2026-09 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22907695). CC BY 4.0."

The September Index figure (16.1% of 286 vendors, five engines, three runs) uses a different sample from Volume I's 35% (85 companies, one engine). These are different samples, not a trend.

## Broadcastwell Launchpad, v2026-10

- [Broadcastwell Launchpad](https://broadcastwell.com/launchpad): Three independent routes: Learn, Refer and Paid work. Free eight-module learning and automatic assessment; independent reviewed referrals; funded careers only. No earnings or employment promise. Most participants may earn nothing.
- [Foundations course](https://app.broadcastwell.com/launchpad/learn): About four hours including assessment, with a useful first exercise in 15 minutes. Open lessons need no account. Completion requires 20/25, all five safety questions, and the structured case. Certificate verification is optional and consented.
- [Fixed partner agreement v2026-10](https://app.broadcastwell.com/launchpad/agreement): Audit $50; Sprint $290 target less commission already paid on one credited fee; program 10% of new retained cash for first 12 paid months. One-time $100 first and $150 third distinct retained retail customer bonuses. No wholesale or white-label schedule. Seven-calendar-day payout after the product refund condition closes and tax forms are complete, subject to earlier mandatory law. Existing accepted rights remain unchanged.
- [Launchpad privacy](https://app.broadcastwell.com/launchpad/privacy): Applicant data remains hiring-only. Enrollment, optional email permission, referral approval and public certificate verification are separate choices. New individual referrers working in CA, MA or NJ are held pending lawyer review; Learn stays open.
